sections.content: NULL means "unknown/missing" — it is not zero, not empty string, not false. Any comparison with NULL yields NULL (not true), so rows silently drop.
Handle with IS NULL / IS NOT NULL, COALESCE(col, default) for fallbacks, NULLIF to convert values to NULL, and careful with aggregates (they skip NULLs).
Key points: COUNT(col) ignores NULLs, SUM/AVG too, columns should be NOT NULL with defaults where "missing" is meaningless, and three-valued logic (true/false/unknown) surprises everyone.

sections.codeExample:
SELECT COALESCE(nickname, name) AS display_name
FROM users;
